summary.text: Pat Duffy is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Hampden District since January 2021 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia, which lists her as Patricia Duffy, gives her education as Concord Carlisle High School, a bachelor's degree from Tufts University and a graduate degree from the University of Georgia, and her profession as legislative aide.
Duffy took office on January 6, 2021, and advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.

For the 2025-2026 session, she was assigned to the Human Resources and Employee Engagement Committee, the House Ways and Means Committee and the Veterans and Federal Affairs and Ways and Means joint committees, and served as vice chair of the Cannabis Policy Joint Committee.
